title: The Second Book of Hook and Draw
summary: Joins the hook and the pulling cut into one motion for students who already hold a first sickle primer.

title: Treatise on Cutting Through Straw and Cord
summary: Trains students to sever cords, straps and bindings with the sickle's tip while guarding against counters.

title: Guard and Counter-Hook for the Working Sickle
summary: Teaches how to take a blow on the blade and answer at once with a hooking counter.

title: Lessons in Qi-Edged Swath Cutting
summary: Shows how to carry qi along a wide sweeping edge while walking steadily forward through an opponent's guard.

title: Handbook of Stepping the Furrow
summary: Links ten sickle motions to the footwork of walking uneven rows, so each cut lands as the foot does.

title: Canon of the Binding Hook and the Pulled Weapon
summary: Instructs students in catching, drawing and holding an opposing weapon with the curved hook of the blade.

title: Study of Moving Cuts Between Standing Rows
summary: Covers cutting while moving through narrow lanes, hedges and crowds, where a long weapon cannot swing.

title: Intermediate Drill-Book of the Weighted Sickle
summary: Builds forearm and qi control with a heavy sickle through nine drills in chopping, hooking and disarming.
